main.description: Reports the outcome of a sign-in started with authorizeHost. Only the user who started it can read it.

status.description: pending until the user finishes signing in, then done or failed.

community.description: The adopted or reconnected community, once done.

signedInAs.description: The account the user signed in as, when it was not the expected one.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: RequestNotFound
errors.description: No sign-in with that request exists for the requesting user.
